title: Maccy: free Paste alternative
caption:
Paste charges $29.99/year. Maccy remembers everything you copy for free 📋

✅ Keeps your copy history, search it as you type
✅ Keyboard-first: open it with Shift + Cmd + C
✅ Pin items you need to keep on top
✅ Skips passwords from your password manager, 100% free

💻 Mac
ℹ️ Needs macOS 14 or later. There's a paid App Store version that supports the dev; the GitHub/Homebrew build is the same app, free

Comment "COPY" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
